screening_decisions.reason: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot of intracervical nitroprusside before IUD insertion; primary outcome was self-reported pain with insertion; acceptable comparator; aligns with outcomes.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of ibuprofen vs placebo prior to IUD insertion; measured self-reported pain immediately following insertion; acceptable comparator.
Randomized trial of full bladder vs immediate emptying; compared women’s pain scores during insertion; intervention could prevent insertion pain; acceptable design and outcomes.

Randomized clinical trial comparing intracervical lidocaine injection vs oral NSAID prior to LNG-IUS insertion; evaluated patient-reported pain immediately after, 2h, and 6h; acceptable active comparator; prespecified outcomes include up to 6h post-insertion.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT of ibuprofen prophylaxis prior to LNG-IUS insertion; measured pain at tenaculum and during insertion; acceptable comparator.
Double-blind, multicenter RCT of vaginal misoprostol vs placebo before IUD insertion; included patient-reported pain during insertion; acceptable comparator.

Randomized, placebo-controlled trial of prophylactic buccal misoprostol in nulliparous women; measured self-reported pain at multiple time points including tenaculum and insertion; acceptable comparator.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of sublingual misoprostol before repeat LNG-IUS insertion; reported insertion pain; acceptable comparator.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of ibuprofen prophylaxis in first-time IUD users; self-reported insertion pain measured; acceptable comparator.
Single-blind RCT of sublingual misoprostol + diclofenac vs diclofenac alone before IUD insertion; measured ease and pain; acceptable active comparator; pain within acceptable outcomes.
Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled study of ibuprofen peri-insertion; pain assessed at insertion and up to 4–6 hours (and beyond); acceptable comparator; matches primary outcomes window.
Randomized, double-blind clinical trial comparing oral tramadol, naproxen sodium, and placebo given 1 hour pre-insertion; insertion pain VAS collected; acceptable comparators.
Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of buccal misoprostol vs placebo in nulliparous women; provider ease and patient-reported pain measured; acceptable comparator.
Randomized, double-blind clinical trial of intracervical 2% lidocaine gel vs placebo; pain VAS at multiple time points including insertion; acceptable comparator.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot trial of vaginal nitroglycerin gel prior to insertion; primary outcome was pain with passage/insertion; acceptable comparator.
Randomized trial comparing 1% lidocaine paracervical block vs no local anesthetic; self-reported pain at tenaculum and during insertion measured; acceptable control (no intervention).
Randomized, double-blind controlled trial of lidocaine gel vs lubricant vs no intervention; insertion pain measured; acceptable controls.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot of intrauterine lidocaine infusion vs saline 3 minutes prior; self-reported pain at insertion; acceptable comparator.
Randomized trial of sublingual misoprostol + diclofenac vs diclofenac alone in nulliparous women; insertion pain (VAS) collected; acceptable active comparator.
Randomized, double-blind trial of vaginal misoprostol vs placebo 4h prior to insertion in nulligravidas; reported reduction in moderate-to-severe pain at insertion; acceptable comparator.

Randomized trial of inhaled lavender aromatherapy vs placebo 30 minutes before insertion; patient-reported insertion pain measured; acceptable comparator; intervention plausibly targets pain perception via anxiety reduction.
Randomized, double-blind trial of self-administered misoprostol vs placebo 3–4 hours pre-insertion in nulliparous women; patient-reported pain pre/post insertion captured; acceptable comparator.
Randomized, placebo-controlled phase-II trial of novel topical lidocaine (cervical/uterine application) vs placebo; significant reduction in maximum insertion pain; acceptable comparator.

Prospective, single-blinded, controlled three-arm study of 1% lidocaine paracervical block vs placebo vs no treatment; women graded pain at tenaculum, insertion, and 5 minutes. Randomization not explicit; include conservatively pending full text.
Registered randomized clinical trial of misoprostol vs placebo prior to IUD insertion in nulliparous women; primary outcome pain at insertion; acceptable comparator.

Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial (abstract) of self-administered vaginal 2% lidocaine gel vs placebo 5 minutes pre-insertion in nulliparous women; pain at multiple time points including tenaculum and insertion; acceptable comparator.
